subject: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps - ZenHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps - ZenHealth
Attachments: zenhealth_map_apr2026.pdf, redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.xlsx

Hi Alex - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and recommended next steps so your procurement and infra teams have a clear starting point. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain / goals we heard:
- Production latency spikes during end-of-month batch runs and clinician peak hours (current infra p95 ~1.2s for 512-token responses).
- Data isolation and HIPAA controls required for PHI workflows (segregation from other tenants, KMS support).
- Predictable throughput for inference-heavy features (goal: sustained 60-80 rps for short prompts; burst to 200 rps).
- Cost target: minimize per-token costs while ensuring p95 latency under 400ms for 512 tokens.

Redwood recommended configuration (initial):
- Dedicated: 3 reserved nodes (each node: 4x A10G GPUs equivalent) - provides predictable throughput and isolation.
- Option B (higher perf): 2 reserved nodes with A100 80GB (if you prioritize lower latency over unit cost) - we sized this in the attached pricing sheet.
- Autoscaling: allow burst pool of 2 additional nodes (on-demand) to cover traffic spikes; typical warmup via KV cache reduces cold-starts.
- Isolation: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS (BYOK) for encryption-at-rest and envelope encryption; audit logs forwarded to your SIEM.
- SLA targets we can commit to for Dedicated: 99.95% uptime, p95 inference latency target <= 400ms for 512-token responses under the reserved profile; rollback policy and multi-region fallback available for high-availability setups.

Immediate next steps / asks:
1) I'll share a Mutual Action Plan (attached) and pricing sheet - please confirm which config (3x A10G nodes vs 2x A100) you want priced for procurement.
2) Can you share the security contacts who will take the SOC2 questionnaire? We can share a redacted SOC2 summary now (attached) and a completion timeline for any additional artifacts.
3) Let's schedule a follow-up on Fri Apr 9 to walk procurement through pricing and the contract timeline. Are you available at 10am PT?

Notes for our internal team (Dev / Neha): please review the sizing assumptions in the pricing sheet and flag anything we should tighten before sending to ZenHealth procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Rivera <alex@zenhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0700

Hi Marissa - appreciate the write-up, looks right to me. A few clarifying q's before we loop procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the security isolation controls for the dedicated pool? We need tenant-level network isolation and proof of BYOK/KMS integration (our security team will want to see key rotation policies).
2) For the autoscaling/burst nodes: what is the expected cold-start latency and how does Redwood manage cache warmup for model weights/KV cache? We want to avoid large latency spikes during bursts.
3) Pricing: can you give a ballpark monthly commit for the 3x A10G config vs the 2x A100 config so procurement has something to evaluate?

Procurement: looping in your side to start the timeline - we want to review the MAP and any standard SOW/contract language on dedicated capacity.

If it helps, we are targeting an on-contract start mid-May. 10am PT on Apr 9 works for me - I've tentatively added the time.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Product Manager, ML Platform | ZenHealth
alex@zenhealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps - ZenHealth

Marissa / Neha - quick internal note to confirm technical fit and answers to Alex's q's: 

- Isolation: Dedicated pool runs inside a customer-dedicated namespace with VPC peering and private endpoints. We support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) for model & data encryption; key rotation and audit logs are surfaced via the Redwood Console and can be integrated with your KMS rotation policy. I'll attach a short security snippet for procurement.
- Autoscaling/burst behavior: Burst nodes are provisioned from a warm pool when possible - cold-start for a fresh node (no cached weights) can be 20-40s depending on model size; for our recommended configuration most common models are cached and typical warmup is <5s for KV cache-only bursts.
- Sizing: based on your usage profile (60-80 sustained rps with 200rps bursts, median prompt length ~250 tokens), 3x A10G nodes should meet throughput and keep unit cost lower. If you need stricter p95 latency (<250ms), recommend 2x A100 80GB.

Attached to the outbound email: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.xlsx (detailed cost split) and zenhealth_map_apr2026.pdf (MAP). Suggest we include a short appendix in MAP for SOC2 artifacts and timelines.

I can join the Apr 9 call and cover the technical section.
- Dev

- Autoscaling / warmup: Dev's notes above are accurate. For the initial deployment we'll provision a warm standby to minimize cold-start impact during your March/April peak windows.
- Pricing: attached pricing sheet has a clear monthly estimate for both configs and a 12-month reserved pricing line (savings shown). For procurement convenience I've also added a DocuSign link for a starter MSA + SOW draft: https://docusign.example.com/zenhealth/msas/4391 (this is a preview link - final pricing locked after your confirmation).

1) Procurement reviews the attached MAP & pricing sheet (procurement@zenhealth.com).
2) Security team to request any additional artifacts and we will schedule a 30-minute security sync with our security engineer (please propose 2 times).
3) Confirm config choice (3x A10G vs 2x A100) by Apr 14 to hit a mid-May start.
4) Follow-up call: Apr 9 at 10am PT - invite sent.
